A late entry joins an original league table after it was played and plays every setup of that table once, in matches of its own. Its games count in no standings table, no league table, no Hype Cup input and no other setup's numbers. The numbers here come from its own late-entry games only, computed as for a setup in a league.

Error rate and risk judgement: 95% intervals, whole games resampled. Ability d′ and caution c at the 0.001 margin: rates corrected by adding 0.5 to the counts and 1 to the totals; 95% intervals, blocks of two seat-swapped games resampled. Cut off: answers that stopped at an output limit the request sent (finish reason length, stop reason max_tokens, finishReason MAX_TOKENS, incomplete max_output_tokens), in the stored response or error. Effort: the reasoning effort the requests sent. Engine's best play: the share of its scored decisions that chose the engine's best play (equity loss under the best-play threshold). Time: median request seconds per decision (waits between retries not included). Cost per 1,000 decisions: the recorded tokens at the price shown, as labelled there (list or billed price; for a setup on our GPUs the hosted model's list price, not billed).

Meta's Muse Ember through OpenRouter, pinned to Meta (fallbacks off) for every decision; never on our GPUs. Late entry to the original League 1 table (not in standings, not eligible for the Hype Cup); its matches were played on 10–11 Nov 2026. It played 17 of its 19 opponents: its pair with Mercury Decide was not played (Mercury Decide is no longer served on OpenRouter; match #932 stopped before any decision, unbilled; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov) and its pair with GPT-6 Luna was not played (GPT-6 Luna's API was out of credit; outside the requested scope, Ümit, 12 Nov). Every request sent reasoning_effort "max"; 21.76 M of its 22.09 M output tokens were reasoning. The endpoint returned no token probabilities, so it answers with one letter, read from the reply; 46 of its 1,713 answers named no option and a random legal play was made. A quality check (12 Nov) found that 1 of those 46 was an OpenRouter provider error (no answer) scored as invalid, in match #926; the other 45 were real length cuts. A full Run 2 of match #926 (same seed, fixed runner 175141f, its own database) played 6 games to 0 against Random with 0 provider errors; the published numbers keep the original match. Each decision is billed at Meta's list price from the tokens OpenRouter reported.
